properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 9 at 10:00PM EDT until October 9 at 11:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 NM...
Coastal waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20
NM...
Tampa Bay waters...
Waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 to 60 NM...
Waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1130 PM EDT.

* At 958 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near Suwannee
River to 19 nm southwest of Ozello to 42 nm southwest of Longboat
Pass, moving northeast at 35 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels, and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots,
suddenly higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Terra Ceia Bay, D5 Reef, Manatee Nearshore Reef, Howard Frankland
Bridge, Madeira Beach Reef, Longboat Key, Tierra Verde, Belleair
Beach, Cockroach Bay, Md1 Reef, M7 Reef, Anna Maria Island,
Hernando Beach, Saint Armands Key, M8 Reef, M17 Reef, Pass-A-Grille
Channel, Southwest Channel, D6 Reef, and M1 Reef.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.instruction:

expected. If your vessel is caught offshore, immediately secure for
heavy weather. Ensure all crew members are wearing USCG approved Type
I life jackets and nonessential crew are below decks. Deploy jack
lines and harnesses if available. Check life saving equipment,
including batteries on handheld radios, for readiness.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately. If your vessel is caught offshore, immediately secure
for heavy weather. Ensure all crew members are wearing USCG approved
Type I life jackets and nonessential crew are below decks. Deploy
jack lines and harnesses if available. Check life saving equipment,
including batteries on handheld radios, for readiness.

properties.description:
FFWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northern Covington County in south central Alabama...
Southern Crenshaw County in south central Alabama...

* Until midnight CDT.

* At 857 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 3 inches in 1 hour.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Andalusia, Opp, River Falls, Red Level, Dozier, Heath, Gantt,
Straughn, Valley Of Shiloh, Coldwater, Dunns, Rawls, Sanford,
Boston, Searight, Eoda, Wiggins, Rhump, Babbie and Carolina.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Dust Advisory issued October 9 at 6:31PM PDT until October 9 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Elko NV
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Elko Nevada has issued a

* Dust Advisory for...
Southeastern Humboldt County in northwestern Nevada...

* Until 800 PM PDT.

* At 629 PM PDT, a dust channel was over Winnemucca, moving northeast
at 55 mph.

HAZARD...Less than two miles visibility with strong wind in excess
of 40 mph.

SOURCE...Doppler radar.

IMPACT...Hazardous travel.

* Travelers along I-80, and US-95 will be affected by reduced
visibility and strong winds.

Locations impacted include...
Winnemucca, Golconda, and Winnemucca Airport.
properties.instruction:
Blowing dust brings reduced visibility, leading to dangerous driving
conditions. If driving, avoid blowing dust if possible. If caught in
dense blowing dust, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

Motorists should not drive into an area of blowing dust. PULL ASIDE
STAY ALIVE!
